text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган is unable to pass
Нарита Брайан
and ends up losing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After watching Нарита Брайан walk off with
a cool
look on her face, she burns with
the desire not to
let this rivalry end on a
loss.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In order to beat Нарита Брайан, she
decides her
next goal will be the same
as hers—the spring
Tenno Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
